prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Katy, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1046; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the sideswipe collision you were involved in while changing lanes in Katy, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Can you tell me in your own words what happened?

A: I was driving in the right lane on the highway, and I wanted to move over to the left lane to get ready for my exit. I checked my mirror, didn't see anything, and started to move over. Then I felt a bump and heard a loud scraping noise. The other car had come up in my blind spot and clipped the side of my car.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you began changing lanes?

A: No, I didn't see it. I looked in the mirror and the side view, but it must have been in the blind spot.

Q: Were you able to pull over safely after the impact?

A: Yes, I signaled and moved onto the shoulder. Both cars stopped and we exchanged information.

Q: Did you feel any injuries at the scene?

A: I felt a little stiff, but I didn't think much of it. I thought I'd just be sore for a day or two.

Q: Have you since sought medical attention?

A: Yes. The pain in my lower back got worse over the next couple of days, so I went to a doctor. They diagnosed a back strain and told me to rest and take it easy.

Q: Are you currently receiving any treatment?

A: I'm doing physical therapy twice a week, and I'm taking over-the-counter pain relievers when needed.

Q: Have you missed any work because of the injury?

A: I missed a few days, and I've been limiting how much I lift at my job.

Q: Before this collision, did you have any prior problems with your back?

A: No, not that I can recall. I've had no significant back problems before this.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just hope this gets resolved soon.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
